---
name: Skill proposal
about: A new skill, or a substantial extension of an existing one
labels: skill-proposal
---

**The failure mode it prevents**
The confident wrong number that gets produced today without it. One
paragraph, concrete.

**The position it occupies**
Routing, the measurement floor, description, causation, prediction, or the
theory ceiling. A proposal that needs a seventh position will be declined;
argue the position, not the topic.

**Why the existing six do not cover it**

**The eval that would prove it**
A query where behaviour with the skill visibly beats behaviour without it.
